groups.sentence: Instructors who implement a chatbot in their course use the provided disclosure statement.
Meeting organizers tell participants if AI tools will be used in meetings or shared engagements.
A warning about proper AI use and user responsibilities is displayed in the interface when interactive AI use begins.
Administrators tell people how and why AI is used, including where it affects them, and are open about its use.
Everyone discloses AI use to affected stakeholders when AI is used in decision-making processes.
Users have the right to know when they are working with AI, and AI use is disclosed to those affected.
Chatbots and AI chat assistants disclose their scope, non-official status, and potential for incorrect information, and AI is not presented as human.
Applications are not always clear about when users are interacting with AI, so students may not know.
